:::{#thm-whitening-inner-product}
#### A matrix-induced inner product is a dot product of transformed vectors

Let $\matr{A}$ be a $p \times p$ symmetric positive definite matrix,
and let $\matr{W}$ be any $p \times p$ matrix with $\matr{A} = \tp{\matr{W}}\matr{W}$.
Then for all $\vx, \vy \in \reals^p$, the $\matr{A}$-inner product (@def-matrix-induced-inner-product) satisfies

$$
\iprod{\vx}{\vy}_{\matr{A}} = (\matr{W}\vx) \cdot (\matr{W}\vy).
$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\begin{aligned}
\iprod{\vx}{\vy}_{\matr{A}} &= \tp{\vx} \tp{\matr{W}}\matr{W} \vy \\
&= \tp{(\matr{W}\vx)} (\matr{W}\vy) \\
&= (\matr{W}\vx) \cdot (\matr{W}\vy).
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
